name: Accm & Nh Corp.
subject: How Accm & Nh Corp. handles certified payroll
text:
Hello,

I saw your SBE certification in New Jersey, which is why I am writing to
you and not to a list.

I am building WageLens: it works out the Davis-Bacon wage determination
and classification for each worker on a federally funded job, and
produces the weekly WH-347 from that.

Certified firms usually end up on federally assisted work as a
subcontractor, which is where the weekly filing starts.

Two things you should know before deciding whether to reply: WageLens is
new, and I have no results to quote, so I am not going to quote any.

What I would find useful is fifteen minutes on how you do it today: who
works out the classification, what happens when an audit letter arrives,
and what you would not give up. If that is not a good use of your time,
a no closes it and I will not chase.

--
WageLens, a TheVillage company
